messages:
mara: Heads up — scheduling a soft-flip for feature flag 'theta_unpin' in eu-west tonight. Window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Plan is canary -> ramp -> full unpin. Deploybot will post preflight checks at T-10.

deploy-bot: scheduled: theta_unpin soft-flip at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Preflight in 10m. Runbook: /runbooks/ff-softflip. @sre-oncall will get paged on anomalies.

aditya: Can we pin the service version to v2.14 for the canary group? Last time unpin hit cache mismatch when canary had older runtime.

mara: yes — pin runtime=2.14 for canary, then unpin only on successful latency+error checks. Rolling unpin only for traffic routed via model-route-v3.

kevin: Rollback criteria? If p99 latency increases >30% or error rate >0.5% for 5m, auto-drain + rollback. Also abort if cost spike >20% in first 20m. :warning:

olivia: I'll update release notes + support blurb. ETA 30m. Also add quick revert steps for CS.

mara: ramp schedule (canary->prod):
```
0m   -> 1% (canary pin)
10m  -> 10%
20m  -> 50%
40m  -> 100% (full unpin)
```
Verify telemetry (token latency, model-fallbacks, cache-hit) at each step. Wait 5m stable before next step.

sre-oncall: noted; will watch p95/p99, allocator errors, and kernel OOMs. I have dashboard open -> :eyes:

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed. Can run 'deploybot softflip theta_unpin --start 2026-03-21T23:00Z --pin-runtime=2.14'

aditya: executing now in staging to sanity check pool scaling. Will report in 5m.

mara: thanks. If any of you see abnormal fallbacks to smaller models, hit the emergency drain (deploybot drain theta_unpin) and @sre-oncall will escalate.

deploy-bot: action log: preflight ok, scheduled job created, watcher set. Good luck :rocket:
